note: Structured-evidence expectations for the reviewer-authored holdout cells, kept SEPARATE from harness/MATRIX-HOLDOUT.json so that block stays byte-for-byte as the reviewer authored it (round-3 R3-1). Each value is read off that cell's own construction text and adjudicated as its own divergence channel (witness:<field>), so a regression that reached the registered outcome by different evidence still diverges - which is precisely the series-scoping class of R2-1 that h09 exists to guard.
